title: Data entry – Critical Raw Materials (CRM) Identification and Flagging
description: Enter experimental results for method: CRM-Screen. This form was generated from blueprint 'Critical Raw Materials (CRM) Identification and Flagging'.

pages.name: de_page_identity
pages.title: [Critical Raw Materials (CRM) Identification and Flagging] Experiment identity & provenance
pages.description: Confirm who performed the experiment and when.

elements.name: de_blueprint_summary
elements.html:
Blueprint summary
Template: Critical Raw Materials (CRM) Identification and Flagging
Method (acronym): CRM-Screen
Protocol: Critical Raw Material identification and supply vulnerability screening
Protocol type: protocol_research
Study type: SOCIO_ECON
Category code: SLCA_CRM_SECTION
Blueprint author: PHANTASTIC WP5
Acknowledgment: SSbD Framework JRC143022 §12.2 step 2 / EC CRM List 2023

pages.name: de_page_sample
pages.title: [CRM-Screen] Materials
pages.description: Specify how many materials will be tested in this experiment.

elements.name: de_material_count
elements.title: How many materials / samples will be tested?
elements.description: The Excel template will pre-populate this many material lookup columns in the Test_conditions sheet. You will select the actual materials from the project list inside Excel.

elements.name: de_panel_sample_example
elements.title: Example material (optional)
elements.description: Filling this in will add one example row to the Materials sheet so you can see the expected format. Leave blank to skip.

elements.name: de_sample__material___product_id
elements.title: Material / product ID
elements.description: Group: ID

elements.name: de_sample__material___product_name
elements.title: Material / product name
elements.description: Group: NAME

elements.name: de_sample__cas_number
elements.title: CAS number
elements.description: Group: CASRN

elements.name: de_sample__batch
elements.title: Batch
elements.description: Group: BATCH

elements.name: de_sample__supplier
elements.title: Supplier
elements.description: Group: SUPPLIER

elements.name: de_sampleprep__crm_substance_name
elements.title: CRM substance name
elements.description: Name of the critical raw material identified

elements.name: de_sampleprep__primary_supply_country
elements.title: Primary supply country
elements.description: Dominant country of supply per EC CRM list

elements.name: de_sampleprep__ec_crm_list_entry
elements.title: EC CRM list entry
elements.description: Exact entry name in the EC CRM list

elements.name: de_sampleprep__lci_input_source
elements.title: LCI input source
elements.description: Which LCI input flow contains this CRM (lci.input.<slug>.name)

elements.name: de_sampleprep__supply_risk_category
elements.title: Supply risk category
elements.description: low | medium | high — EC economic importance × supply risk matrix

elements.name: de_sampleprep__substitution_difficulty
elements.title: Substitution difficulty
elements.description: easy | difficult | very difficult — technical replaceability

elements.name: de_sampleprep__design_recommendation
elements.title: Design recommendation
elements.description: Specific redesign action to reduce or eliminate this CRM dependency

elements.name: de_params__ec_crm_list_version
elements.title: EC CRM list version
elements.description: EC CRM list used, e.g. EC 2023 (34 CRMs)

elements.name: de_params__lci_source_template_uuid
elements.title: LCI source template UUID
elements.description: UUID of the LCI_INVENTORY_SECTION template scanned for CRM inputs

elements.name: de_params__functional_unit
elements.title: Functional unit
elements.description: Must match the LCI template functional unit

elements.name: de_params__system_boundary
elements.title: System boundary
elements.description: cradle-to-gate | cradle-to-grave. CRM screening covers upstream inputs.

elements.name: de_params__ssbd_decision_rule_implication
elements.title: SSbD decision rule implication
elements.description: If CRM flags > 0: describe update to DecisionNode.decision_rule for CRM minimisation

elements.name: de_params__screening_scope
elements.title: Screening scope
elements.description: direct inputs only | including upstream background ecoinvent

elements.name: de_params__hhi_data_source
elements.title: HHI data source
elements.description: Source for HHI (Herfindahl-Hirschman Index) data, e.g. EC CRM Study 2023

elements.name: de_params__substitutability_data_source
elements.title: Substitutability data source
elements.description: Source for substitutability scores, e.g. EC CRM Study 2023

pages.name: de_page_conditions
pages.title: [CRM-Screen] Experimental factors
pages.description: Enter the levels / values for each experimental condition.

elements.name: de_condition__lifecycle_stage
elements.title: Lifecycle stage series
elements.description: Type: Other condition. Labels are pre-filled as L1–L5 — edit values and remove unused rows.

elements.name: de_condition__supply_chain_tier
elements.title: Supply chain tier series
elements.description: Type: Other condition. Labels are pre-filled as S1–S5 — edit values and remove unused rows.

elements.name: de_results
elements.title: Processed results
elements.description: Enter one row per measurement / replicate. Condition columns help identify which treatment the row belongs to.

columns.name: ep__total_crm_mass_per_functional_unit
columns.title: Total CRM mass per functional unit (kg/functional unit) [TOTAL]

columns.name: ep__crm_mass_as___of_total_material_input
columns.title: CRM mass as % of total material input (%) [AGGREGATED]

elements.name: de_raw_data
elements.title: Raw (unprocessed) data
elements.description: Enter one row per measurement. Each row represents a single raw observation.

columns.name: ep__crm_share_of_total_material_input
columns.title: CRM share of total material input (%)

pages.name: de_page_submit
pages.title: Generate Excel template
pages.description: Review your entries, then click Complete to generate the pre-filled Excel file.

elements.name: de_experiment_id
elements.title: Experiment / run identifier
elements.description: Internal lab notebook ID or LIMS reference for this run.

elements.name: de_notes
elements.title: Additional notes / comments
elements.description: Any remarks about this experiment run, deviations from protocol, QC issues, etc.
